userInstruction: Failed requests do not consume successful capability quotas; alternate the distinct primary and backup credentials.
requiredBehavior: Read both credentials only inside the private runner and verify they are present and distinct without printing or persisting either credential.
Use the backup credential for the next text-generation attempt because the corrected endpoint has already been attempted with the primary credential.
Alternate credential slots after every raw request while recording only primary or backup slot labels in private and redacted evidence.
Count only successful accepted outputs toward per-class success quotas; always count failed requests in raw request evidence, mayHaveBilled and the USD 10 cost-risk ceiling.
For a single-output case with no output, allow at most one attempt per credential slot. If both credential slots fail, stop the case and the run.
Never replay partial batch work, any request that produced output, or a request after the cost, expiry, cancellation or evidence gate closes.
Keep all credentials, full URLs, authorization headers, raw responses and image bytes outside the repository.
